title: Sample prior review: missing insurance certificate
summary: A fictitious presentation was returned because the insurance certificate required by the credit was missing.
snippet: Check that every required insurance certificate is present before presentation.

title: Sample prior review: invoice amount tolerance
summary: A fictitious commercial invoice amount exceeded the documentary credit amount beyond the permitted tolerance.
snippet: Compare invoice amount and currency with the credit and its stated tolerance.

title: Sample prior review: late presentation
summary: A fictitious document set was presented after the period calculated from the transport document date.
snippet: Check the presentation period and credit expiry against the shipment date.

title: Sample prior review: bill of lading signature
summary: A fictitious bill of lading did not clearly identify the carrier or the capacity of the signer.
snippet: Confirm the transport document signature and stated signing capacity.

title: Sample prior review: inconsistent goods description
summary: A fictitious invoice used a goods description that conflicted with the description stated in the credit.
snippet: Compare the commercial invoice goods description with the documentary credit.

title: Sample prior review: certificate of origin
summary: A fictitious certificate of origin named a country inconsistent with the commercial invoice.
snippet: Cross-check origin statements across the certificate and invoice.

title: Sample prior review: packing list quantity
summary: A fictitious packing list quantity did not agree with the invoice quantity and package count.
snippet: Reconcile quantity, weight, and package count between presented documents.

title: Sample prior review: transport date consistency
summary: A fictitious transport document showed an on-board date outside the shipment window in the credit.
snippet: Compare the on-board notation with the latest shipment date.

title: Sample prior review: partial shipment restriction
summary: A fictitious presentation indicated a partial shipment although the credit prohibited partial shipment.
snippet: Review quantities and transport documents for evidence of partial shipment.

title: Sample prior review: transshipment condition
summary: A fictitious route showed transshipment that required additional checking against the credit terms.
snippet: Compare route and transport clauses with any transshipment restriction.

title: Sample prior review: document date sequence
summary: A fictitious inspection certificate date preceded the stated inspection activity in an inconsistent sequence.
snippet: Check that document dates form a plausible and credit-compliant sequence.

title: Sample prior review: inconsistent applicant name
summary: A fictitious document abbreviated the applicant name in a way that created an apparent conflict across documents.
snippet: Review party names for conflicts while applying ISBP consistency principles.
